digest.component_or_area: ticket store, optimistic concurrency, sidecar event reconvergence
propositions: A verified description write (14,997 chars) succeeded and was confirmed on read-back, but a subsequent read returned an older revision (10,582 chars) without error, silently losing data and corrupting acceptance criteria.
Optimistic concurrency protection (ConcurrencyError on conflicting write) did not fire; the write reported success and passed immediate read-back verification yet was silently reverted afterwards.
The ticket was being edited while its own plan-review was running and emitting REVIEW_RESULT sidecar events; store reconvergence between concurrent writers is hypothesized as the cause.
A later unconditional whole-description EDIT carrying stale client-held text became authoritative via last-writer-wins reduction, overwriting a newer description event.
A historical reducer-cache race (fixed in commit 0b964c82f5) could have caused a successful read-back followed by stale cached state on a later read.
